description:
Cast Earth Kingdom General by paying its mana cost
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Earth Kingdom General trigger, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Earth Kingdom General
When Earth Kingdom General dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.
